description: WHEN TO USE: Audits exact prompt-cache economics for one usage receipt on a fixed model and billing channel without changing models, trimming tokens, or lowering effort. DO NOT USE: For 10-turn forward session planning (use pin_single_model_prefix_cache) or multi-turn quality-tier routing (use auto_route_task_by_quality_tier). INPUTS & DEFAULTS: Required model and usage object; channel defaults to "packaged-snapshot"; reusable_uncached_tokens (integer >= 0, optional) must not exceed uncached input tokens. BEHAVIOR: Stateless read-only decimal math; zero upstream calls; refuses unverified quotes instead of guessing $0. OUTPUT: JSON with normalized usage, usd.rate_card_with_reported_cache, usd.same_usage_without_cache, usd.cache_difference_vs_uncached, and projected_warm_cost.

actual_billed_usd.description: Optional invoiced amount in USD decimal string notation (e.g. "0.0025").

channel.description: Exact billing channel to price against (e.g. "packaged-snapshot", "openrouter", "direct:openai"). Defaults to the dated packaged snapshot.

model.description: Canonical provider/model ID on the invoice or usage receipt (e.g. "openai/gpt-4o-2024-11-20" or "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5").

reusable_uncached_tokens.description: Optional byte-identical uncached prefix token count eligible for future warm cache reads; must be <= uncached input tokens.

usage.description: Raw provider token usage counters only (never include prompt text, messages, or API keys).

cached_tokens.description: Cached read tokens subset of prompt_tokens.

prompt_tokens.description: OpenAI-style inclusive total input tokens (includes cached tokens).

name: analyze_same_model_cache
